player_prompt.intro:
A le tin {difficulty} RushHour puzzle. Ṣíì ọkọ̀ lọ́nà tọ́ ṣẹ́gun ọkọ̀ pupa [X] kí ó tó lọ sí òpin òtún.
Ṣíṣẹ́: [A+], [B-], bẹ́ẹ̀bẹ́ẹ̀. (+ = síwájú, - = síyèyè).

invalid_move.wrong_format: Azo kloklo. Kpọ nu wɛ format [A+] / [B-].
invalid_move.no_car: A sɔ mɔto '{car_id}' ɖo ta ɔ mɛ ă.

game_message.solved: Hwevɔvi ɔ ɖo yiyi wɛ! A ɖe nùɖé lɛ kpɔ́n.

outcome.win: Nǔ e è mɔ d'é wú ɔ́ fó!
